in.other_title: Post hoc YES-on-NO outcomes in released logs
in.rationale: The post hoc false-acceptance counts are computed from the released transcripts.
in.scope: Counts cover the 115 NO-labelled items in each of the 18 released cells; all scored outputs come from qwen2.5:7b, including the nine cells whose manifest names qwen2.5:3b. The counts are post hoc and descriptive, with no model execution or hypothesis testing.

in.rationale: The exact-fraction inequality uses the same released paired outcomes and has no prospective content.
in.scope: The observation depends on these records rather than being evidence for them: it is computed from the released paired outcomes (its source_record is ../released_sample_audit.json). It covers six released paired direct and debate conditions with 115 NO-label items each, not all 5,400 scored samples in the eighteen archived cells. Every row was judged by ollama/qwen2.5:7b, including the three rows whose released batch label is ollama/qwen2.5:3b. The relation is post hoc on released data and not held out.
